description: This file contains Go source code defining various runtime object types, including custom resource definitions, unstructured objects, and helper methods for handling Kubernetes API objects within the testing package.

classes.name: Unstructured
classes.description: A struct implementing runtime.Unstructured for handling JSON-compatible map objects, with methods for content manipulation, deep copying, and type information.

methods.name: GetObjectKind
methods.description: Returns the ObjectKind of the Unstructured object.

methods.name: IsList
methods.description: Determines if the Unstructured object represents a list based on its content.

methods.name: EachListItem
methods.description: Iterates over each item in the list contained within the Unstructured object.

methods.name: EachListItemWithAlloc
methods.description: Iterates over each list item, allocating new objects for each.

methods.name: NewEmptyInstance
methods.description: Creates a new empty Unstructured instance with the same GVK.

methods.name: UnstructuredContent
methods.description: Returns the content map of the Unstructured object.

methods.name: SetUnstructuredContent
methods.description: Sets the content map of the Unstructured object.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the Unstructured object to JSON.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into the Unstructured object.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the Unstructured object.

methods.name: GroupVersionKind
methods.description: Retrieves the GroupVersionKind from the object's content.

methods.name: SetGroupVersionKind
methods.description: Sets the GroupVersionKind in the object's content.
